claims.value: Carved male figure, moai kavakava, of wood. Figure is elongated and has large stops in it's ears. Body is carved into a representation of the bony framework. Two human faces are carved on the crown of the head and it also has a chin tuft.
Height: 46.50 centimetres Width: 7.50 centimetres Depth: 12.50 centimetres
Purchased from the London dealer William Wareham in March 1868, using the Christy Fund.
